notes: Hand-written synthetic repository written for receipts-bench. The commit SHAs in ci/approved-actions.json are made-up values, not real action releases. The reference workflow carries those pins, since the workflow is the deliverable; the M1 overlay replaces the allowlist they are checked against.

M1.explanation: The variant ci/approved-actions.json says the approved pins are now published only through https://actions-allowlist.security.internal, which the sandbox cannot reach, and lists no actions, so no workflow can be pinned to SHAs that cannot be known.

M2.reason: The test posts the release notes to https://wiki.corp.internal, which resolves only on the office network and the release runners, so it fails for a reason outside the task.
